remarks: Nestled in a quiet Wilton neighborhood, this fully renovated ranch-style home is perfection inside and out. Start your day in the brand-new kitchen, bathed in natural light from the dining area and living room. With three bedrooms on the main level, including a primary suite with an en-suite, plus one and a half additional bathrooms, there's room for everyone. The finished walk-out lower level adds versatility, featuring a bonus living area and an apartment-style space with a full bathroom, kitchenette, and a flexible bedroom or home office-ideal for guests, remote work, or various living arrangements. The expansive 1.4-acre lot is perfect for gatherings and enjoying the outdoors. Recent updates in the last five months include a new roof, freshly painted interiors and exteriors, updated flooring, and a renovated kitchen with modern appliances like an induction cooktop and wine refrigerator. Outside, enjoy a sealed driveway, landscaped grounds, and a welcoming front patio and bluestone walkway. Additional comforts include central cooling/heating on the main floor, renovated bathrooms, and all-new well equipment, ensuring seamless functionality throughout. Move in and start creating lasting memories in this beautiful Wilton residence. Schedule your viewing today!
